mapper.select: SELECT at_risk_high AS highRiskCount, churn_rate AS churnRate, ROUND(100.0 * conversion_count / NULLIF(intervention_count, 0), 1) AS conversionRate, attributed_revenue AS attributedRevenue FROM churn_daily_metric ORDER BY metric_date DESC LIMIT 1
WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, risk_level FROM churn_score ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC ) SELECT risk_level AS riskLevel, COUNT(*) AS count FROM latest GROUP BY risk_level

WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, risk_type FROM churn_score ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC ) SELECT risk_type AS riskType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM latest GROUP BY risk_type ORDER BY count DESC

WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, risk_level FROM churn_score ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN um.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'MEMBER' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS segment, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN l.risk_level = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high FROM latest l LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_membership WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ) um ON um.user_id = l.user_id GROUP BY segment
SELECT metricDate, churnRate FROM ( SELECT metric_date AS metricDate, churn_rate AS churnRate FROM churn_daily_metric ORDER BY metric_date DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent ORDER BY metricDate ASC

SELECT ri.action_type AS actionType, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ri.is_control THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS treatPct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ri.is_control AND io.converted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ri.is_control THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS controlPct, SUM(COALESCE(io.revenue_amount, 0)) AS revenue FROM retention_intervention ri LEFT JOIN intervention_outcome io ON io.intervention_id = ri.intervention_id GROUP BY ri.action_type ORDER BY revenue DESC

WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, score, risk_level, risk_type FROM churn_score ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC ) SELECT l.user_id AS userId, u.name AS name, l.score AS score, l.risk_level AS riskLevel, l.risk_type AS riskType, CASE WHEN um.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS isMember FROM latest l JOIN users u ON u.user_id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_membership WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ) um ON um.user_id = l.user_id ORDER BY l.score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
